verification_method: Direct OCP BRepAlgoAPI_Common on exported STEP geometry. Final STL/assembly bytes and STEP DATA sections rechecked against the completed native submission.

label_visibility.method: First-hit rays from front at stated elevation to nominal label-face/line centers. Positive first_surface_lead_mm >2 indicates another surface in front of the label, beyond engraving tolerance. Targets derived from submitted label face centers and 9 mm line pitch.
